## purpose of this blog
The purpose of this blog is to document this course. It is both a way to review my notes, especially the most complex parts, and a way to practice my skills in Quarto.

## creating the blog
Creating the blog was actually fairly easy. All we need to do is open VScode and create a new project. Then, we select the Quarto blog and that's it! The blog skeleton is created and we can now personalise it. 

## blog structure
We will have one post for every day of the course, so five in total. What we need to do for this is have a "posts" folder where we will create a new folder for every day. There, we will write inside the index.qmd file, which contains the content of this post.  

## publishing it on github
First, we create a new repository on github. Then:
```bash
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Initial blog"
git remote add origin https://github.com/<user>/<repo>.git
git branch -M main
git push -u origin main
```
